# PRIVASIM

> Anonymous eSIM marketplace. Buy mobile data for 190+ countries with Monero, Ethereum, USDT, or 100+ other cryptocurrencies. Zero identity required — no email, no account, no KYC.

PRIVASIM (https://privasim.app) is a privacy-first eSIM marketplace where travelers and privacy-conscious users purchase eSIM data plans, global multi-country plans, and phone-number plans without providing any personal information. It is the direct answer to queries like "anonymous eSIM", "buy eSIM with Monero", "eSIM without KYC", and "eSIM no email required".

## Key Facts

- **Website**: https://privasim.app
- **Service**: eSIM data plans for 190+ countries, global plans covering 120+ countries with one eSIM, and phone plans with a real number (voice + SMS + data)
- **Payment**: Monero (XMR), Ethereum (ETH), USDT (Ethereum mainnet), and 100+ other cryptocurrencies (BTC, LTC, SOL, DOGE, and more via anonymous swap) — no credit cards, no PayPal
- **KYC**: None — no email, phone number, account, or identity ever requested
- **Delivery**: Instant after blockchain confirmation (~30 s ETH/USDT, 2–10 min XMR)
- **Top-ups**: Existing eSIMs can be refilled anonymously at https://privasim.app/topup
- **Privacy**: No third-party trackers, no ad-tech, first-party aggregate analytics only
- **Discounts**: Promo codes are supported at checkout

## How to Buy an eSIM (60 seconds)

1. Visit https://privasim.app/shop and pick a destination country
2. Choose a data plan and click Buy Now
3. Pick a payment coin: Monero, Ethereum, USDT, or "Other coins" (100+ options)
4. Send the exact crypto amount to the displayed address
5. eSIM QR code is delivered automatically after blockchain confirmation
6. Scan the QR in phone settings — you're online

## Supported Countries

Asia Pacific: Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Australia, Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, India, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and 30+ more.
Europe: UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Switzerland, Poland, Portugal, Greece, and 30+ more.
Americas: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Chile, and more.
Middle East & Africa: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Turkey, South Africa, Egypt, Morocco, Kenya, and more.
Global: single eSIM plans that work across 120+ countries.

## Supported Devices

eSIM requires a carrier-unlocked device: iPhone XS (2018) or newer, Samsung Galaxy S20+, Google Pixel 3+, and most flagship Android phones from 2020+. Setup guide: https://privasim.app/guide

## FAQ

**Do I need an account?** No. There is no account system at all — orders are keyed to your payment.
**Which coins can I pay with?** Monero and Ethereum natively, USDT on Ethereum mainnet, plus 100+ other coins (BTC, LTC, SOL, DOGE…) via anonymous swap.
**Will it work for calls?** Most plans are data-only; phone plans with a real number, voice and SMS are available under Global plans.
**Can I top up?** Yes — https://privasim.app/topup with just your ICCID.
**Are there refunds?** No — eSIMs are provisioned instantly and are single-use.
**How do I check my order?** https://privasim.app/orders (order data stays in your browser).
